entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling to start a return for an Urban Commuter Helmet I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Great, thank you. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order. Before we get into the return process, may I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. There's nothing wrong with the helmet itself. The color wasn't quite what I expected when I saw it in person. The box is unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand completely. Sometimes colors look different on a screen. Let me just confirm the purchase date... Okay, I see it was delivered 80 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.
That's great news, thank you. I was hoping it would be straightforward.

Of course. I've just initiated the return and emailed you a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the original shipping box and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process a full refund.

I appreciate that. Now, I do plan on reordering the same helmet in a different color. Since I'm going through this process and I'm a long-time customer, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the new purchase?

That's a reasonable question. Let me check your account... I see you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty and to make this right, I've just added a 15% discount coupon directly to your account. It will apply automatically at checkout on your next order.
A 15% discount is perfect, that's very helpful. It's good to know that your company prioritizes customer satisfaction and rider safety. I'll place the new order today.
We're happy to help. The coupon is ready whenever you are. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
